subject: CypherData: Security artifact checklist & PO provisioning
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
To: CypherData Procurement <procurement@cypherdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CypherData: Security artifact checklist & PO provisioning

Hi Elena / Procurement team,

Thanks for agreeing to move forward — excited to get CypherData onboarded. Before we can finalize contracting and issue the PO on our side, procurement has requested a short set of security/compliance artifacts so we can clear the vendor gating checklist. At a minimum we need: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 letter)
- ISO 27001 certificate (if available)
- Pen test executive summary or remediation attestation
- Primary billing contact + legal contact for PO/SOW

Can you confirm whether you can share the above (even as redacted PDFs) and an approximate ETA? If you prefer to upload a single archive, that works too — please name it so the procurement system can automatically attach it to the vendor record.

Next steps from our side once we receive artifacts:
- Marissa (procurement lead) will create the vendor record and route the PO path.
- Karthik (security) will do a quick intake review and flag any gaps.
- We’ll aim to have a draft PO within 2 business days of artifact receipt.

If there are any contractual prerequisites (data residency, subprocessor list, insurance cert), call them out up front so we can include them in routing.

Thanks — attaching a short vendor intake form (stub) you can fill if easier.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Quick notes:
- SOC 2 Type II: attached (PDF) — covers Jun 2026–Jun 2027.
- Pen test: executive summary attached; full report is under NDA but we can provide a remediation attestation.
- ISO 27001: we maintain certification, attaching cert file.
- Billing contact: finance@cypherdata.com (please route PO there).
- Legal contact: Tom Blake (cc’d) — Tom can confirm any contract language exceptions.

ETA: bundle attached now; if you need anything redacted, let me know by EOD Monday and we’ll fast-track.

Attachments: CypherData_Security_Attachments.zip (zip, 4 files), SOC2_TypeII_cert.pdf (PDF), PenTest_Summary.pdf (PDF)

Elena — got the bundle, thanks for the fast turnaround. I confirmed receipt with procurement. A couple of clarifications so we can move PO provisioning without blockers: 

1) For SOC 2: is there a public-facing letter we can store on our vendor record, or do we need to keep the full report under restricted access? If restricted, we’ll note the access controls in the vendor profile.
2) For the pen test: if you can add a one-sentence remediation attestation (e.g., "Critical findings remediated as of MM/DD/YYYY"), that will satisfy our security intake.
3) Billing: please have procurement@cypherdata.com confirm the legal name and remit-to address for the PO header.

Marissa — can you start the vendor record and flag the related HubSpot deal (DEAL-9834)? Karthik — please confirm whether the attached SOC2/pen summary is sufficient or whether you want additional artifacts. Dylan — once PO is created, what is our expected internal approval timeline (budget/finance)?

If we can get confirmations by Monday EOD, we’ll aim to generate the initial PO Tuesday morning.

Best,
Aisha

Subject: Internal: CypherData onboarding checklist & owners (procurement action)

Team — quick internal checklist to close vendor gate for CypherData (DEAL-9834):

- Create vendor record in Coupa/Ariba (Marissa) — include attachments and link to HubSpot deal.
- Security intake review (Karthik) — verify SOC2 date range and accept pen test attestation or request remediation note.
- Finance routing (Dylan) — expected approval window for PO: 24 hours once vendor record complete; please confirm any budget holds.
- Legal check (Aisha) — coordinate with Tom Blake if there are contract language exceptions; escalate if indemnity/PD limits differ.

Please update this thread as you complete each item. Marissa, can you confirm vendor record number when created so we can include it on the PO? Karthik, if you want the full pen test under NDA let me know and I’ll request access from Elena.

Thanks — I’ll assemble the final packet for procurement once we have confirmations.

Aisha
